subject: Request: remove single conversation (case CX-4471) from audit logs
body:
From: Alicia Grant <alicia.grant@acmehealth.com>
To: support@redwood.ai
Cc: Henry Chu <henry.chu@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:15:24 -0400
Subject: Request to remove single conversation from logs (CX-4471)

Hi Support,

We've identified a single customer-facing conversation tied to request ID CX-4471 that contains PII we need removed from your hosted logs per our data retention policy and a pending DSAR. Can you confirm whether Redwood can redact or permanently delete that one conversation from the audit/tokens logs for our account (Acme Health)? We only need CX-4471 removed — do not affect other data.

Relevant details:
- Account: Acme Health (acct-id: AH-9989)
- Request ID: CX-4471
- Approximate timestamp: 2026-06-28T15:03:12Z
- Region: us-east-1 (hosted)

Please let me know the process, time-to-complete, and any evidence you can provide once done. Happy to sign any required attestation.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Grant
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Acme Health

---

On Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:58:11 -0700, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Alicia Grant <alicia.grant@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:58:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to remove single conversation from logs (CX-4471)

Hi Alicia — thanks for the details and for flagging this. Looping in Monica (CSM) and David (Security) to scope and confirm feasibility. A few quick clarifying questions to speed this along: 

1) Is the conversation only in our hosted API audit logs (token-level telemetry and request/response hashes), or does it also appear in a customer-uploaded backup or S3 export?
2) Do you have the exact message fragment(s) or a checksum we should match against?
3) Are you asking for removal from all retention backends (live logs, archived logs, and any backup snapshots)?

We typically can remove associated request IDs from our hosted audit index and related debug logs; however, full deletion from immutable backups may require legal/records approvals and could take longer. Monica — can you coordinate with the account team and confirm whether Acme has any recent exports?

I will also escalate to David for a technical assessment and estimate.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: support_case_CX-4471.pdf (support-case export stub)

On Fri, 2 Jul 2026 13:05:49 -0400, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Grant <alicia.grant@acmehealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 13:05:49 -0400
Subject: Re: Request to remove single conversation from logs (CX-4471)

Short answer: yes, we can remove the conversation footprint tied to CX-4471 from the hosted audit index and operational debug logs. Caveats and details below.

What we can do now (hosted):
- Identify records keyed by request ID CX-4471 across our telemetry index and remove those rows.
- Purge associated token-level cache entries and any transient KV cache created during the session.
- Provide a redacted audit extract (redwood_audit_snippet.json) showing before/after hashes and a confirmation stamp for your records.

Limitations and next steps:
- Archived backups and long-term immutable snapshots (cold storage) are on a 90-day retention schedule and deletions from immutable backups require a records-retention exception and sign-off from Legal. We will start that process if you require deletion from archives.
- If Acme exported logs to an S3 bucket on your side, we cannot remove those — please confirm.
- We will need an authorized written attestation from Acme to proceed with archive exception requests.

Estimated turnaround: removal from live/operational logs: 48–72 hours after approval. Archive exception (if requested): 7–14 business days depending on legal review.

Action requested from Acme:
1) Confirm you only want live/operational logs cleaned (yes/no).
2) If you want archives purged as well, reply with the authorized attestation and a contact for legal.

I will kick off the live removal after Karthik confirms authorization.

-David
David Kim
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_audit_snippet.json (redacted evidence stub)
